title: 如何在塞尔达完成载人航天

scenes.kicker: 机制拆解 · 第 5 期
scenes.title: 载人航天

lines.zh: 王国之泪的玩家，早就用究极手把林克送上天好几回了。
lines.en: Tears of the Kingdom players have launched Link into the sky with Ultrahand more times than anyone can count.

lines.zh: 那这玩意儿到底是怎么做出来的？
lines.en: So how does this thing actually work?

lines.zh: 任天堂没给代码，我只能自己写一个。顺便定个小目标：在网页里，完成一次载人航天。
lines.en: Nintendo didn't share the code, so I wrote my own. Small goal while I'm at it: a crewed spaceflight, in a web page.

lines.zh: 网页版直接能玩，链接在简介。点赞、收藏、关注之后，我把地址私信发你。
lines.en: The web version is playable right now; link in the description. Like, favorite and follow, and I'll DM you the address.

lines.zh: 先看任天堂自己怎么说。GDC 2024 上，王国之泪的物理负责人讲了一条铁律：
lines.en: First, what Nintendo says. At GDC 2024, the game's physics lead laid down one iron rule:
lines.say: 先看任天堂自己怎么说。G D C 二零二四 上，王国之泪的物理负责人讲了一条铁律：

lines.zh: 世界里所有东西，都必须是刚体加约束。没有例外。
lines.en: Everything in the world must be rigid bodies plus constraints. No exceptions.

lines.zh: 以前很多机关是按动画硬推的。在物理引擎眼里，它们重得没有上限。
lines.en: A lot of old contraptions were pushed by animation. To the physics engine, they're infinitely heavy.

lines.zh: 结果就是：你塞块冰到闸门底下，闸门直接把冰按进地里，还在那抽搐。
lines.en: So if you slide a block of ice under a gate, the gate shoves it into the floor and keeps twitching.

lines.zh: 改成真物理以后，冰把闸门顶住了，还顺便多出来一种解法。
lines.en: With real physics, the ice holds the gate up, and that even opened up a new solution.

lines.zh: 好，规矩懂了。开工。
lines.en: Okay, rules understood. Let's build.

lines.zh: 第一步，抓东西。从屏幕中间打一条射线，打中哪，就抓哪。
lines.en: Step one: grab. Fire a ray from the middle of the screen; whatever it hits, you hold.

lines.zh: 新手写法，是每帧直接把它挪到你面前。效果嘛，穿墙，还顺手把箱子全挤飞。
lines.en: The beginner way is to teleport it in front of you every frame. Result: it phases through walls and launches every crate.

lines.zh: 正确写法，是给它一个速度，让它自己飞过去。墙挡着就是挡着，这才叫物理。
lines.en: The right way is to give it a velocity and let it fly there. If a wall's in the way, it stops. That's physics.

lines.zh: 第二步，转。一下四十五度，转完对齐。不然你这辈子都摆不正一块木板。
lines.en: Step two: rotate. Forty-five degrees a press, then snap. Otherwise you'll never get a plank straight.

lines.zh: 第三步，找粘哪儿。举着东西的时候，每一帧都在算：离我最近的是谁，差多远。
lines.en: Step three: where to glue. While you're holding something, every frame asks: who's closest, and how far?

lines.zh: 够近了，就拉出这根线，意思是：松手就粘这儿。
lines.en: Close enough, and this line appears. It means: let go and it sticks here.

lines.zh: 第四步，粘。这里有个岔路口。
lines.en: Step four: glue. Here the road forks.

lines.zh: 要么两块还是两块，中间加个关节拉着；要么干脆焊成一整块。
lines.en: Either they stay two pieces with a joint holding them, or you weld them into one solid thing.

lines.zh: 拿座桥试试，砸块石头。关节版会弯会晃，焊死的那版纹丝不动。
lines.en: Let's test a bridge and drop a rock. The joint version bends and wobbles; the welded one doesn't budge.

lines.zh: 游戏里用的哪种？任天堂没说。我猜是关节，因为大家造的车都在晃。
lines.en: Which one does the game use? Nintendo never said. My guess is joints, because everyone's cars wobble.

lines.zh: 第五步，搬。抓住一块，整坨都得跟着走。
lines.en: Step five: carry. Grab one piece and the whole build has to come along.

lines.zh: 要是只拽一块，后面全靠关节拖着，长了就成了面条。
lines.en: Drag just one piece and the rest hangs off the joints. Make it long and you've got noodles.

lines.zh: 所以每一块都朝同一个目标一起动，就稳了。
lines.en: So every piece moves toward the same target together, and it holds.

lines.zh: 还有，玩家测出来一次最多粘二十一个零件。为什么是二十一？任天堂没解释。
lines.en: Also, players found you can glue at most 21 parts. Why 21? Nintendo never explained.

lines.zh: 我猜跟这个有关：零件越多，越难算。物理引擎只算一遍是面条，算八遍才站得直。
lines.en: My guess: more parts, harder math. Let the engine iterate once and it's a noodle; eight times and it stands up.

lines.zh: 第六步，上动力。风扇很简单，就是一直在它屁股后面推。
lines.en: Step six: power. A fan is simple: it just keeps pushing from behind.

lines.zh: 轮子得能转，所以只能用转轴连着，再加个马达去拧。
lines.en: A wheel has to spin, so it hangs on an axle joint with a motor turning it.

lines.zh: 任天堂说，游戏里压根没有车辆程序。车，就是轮子加木板，自己凑出来的。
lines.en: Nintendo says there's no vehicle code at all. A car is just wheels and planks that happen to add up.

lines.zh: 载人航天，第一次尝试。一块木板，四根火箭，一位乘客。点火。
lines.en: Crewed spaceflight, attempt one. One plank, four rockets, one passenger. Ignition.

lines.zh: 很好，关节全断了。乘客没事，他自己说的。
lines.en: Great, every joint snapped. The passenger is fine. He says so himself.

lines.zh: 第二次，换成焊死的合并模式。三，二，一。
lines.en: Attempt two, switched to welded merge mode. Three, two, one.

lines.zh: 起飞了。再高一点，再高一点。
lines.en: Liftoff. Higher. Higher.

lines.zh: 海拉鲁上空，任务完成。
lines.en: Above Hyrule. Mission complete.

scenes.title: 去发射吧

lines.zh: 网页版在简介，你也可以去把自己送上天。点赞、收藏、关注，我私信把地址发你。
lines.en: The web version is in the description; go launch yourself. Like, favorite and follow, and I'll DM you the address.

lines.zh: 我是粑粑柑，下期见。
lines.en: I'm Babagan. See you next time.
